items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: The owner of the newspaper, Jim Gottlieb took a shine to me. And the paper was never published without a picture or a quote from Fillius.

ctx.x: I was president of the Chamber of Commerce for a couple of years. And all that stuff. And at one point the city fathers wanted me to run for mayor. And I told them I couldn’t afford to because the twelve thousand dollars that was the stipend for the mayor was exactly the amount of my alimony. So they said we’ll make it up to you. I said oh no, we don’t do that. But without blowing smoke, I could been elected mayor easy. The owner of the newspaper, Jim Gottlieb took a shine to me. And the paper was never published…
Do you have any of those?
